derivation: from a compound of G5056 (τέλος) and G5342 (φέρω);
def: to be a bearer to completion (maturity), i.e. to ripen fruit (figuratively)

occurrences.text: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
